title: Rear window shades and visibility
summary: This topic centers on rear window shades, with a few clear complaints about visibility and shade operation but most sampled mentions remaining too ambiguous or mixed with other window-related subjects to assign a clear sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive feedback praises the rear roller blinds as a liked comfort feature.

negative.summary: Negative feedback focuses on the rear window blind not closing properly and the rear sun shade making rearward visibility difficult because it appears too dark.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined mentions include rear shade visibility concerns, shades getting stuck or not raising, and unrelated side or rear window comments that lack enough context for clear sentiment.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are labeled undetermined, so the evidence for clear sentiment is limited.
The cluster mixes rear sun shades with other window-related issues such as side windows, window controls, and window trim, so it is not fully coherent.
Some examples describe functional problems but are still labeled undetermined, which limits how specifically they can be summarized in sentiment sections.
